subject: Renewal + Dedicated expansion: amendment & billing cadence for Cortico
messages:
From: Lisa Huang <lisa@cortico.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom White <tom.white@cortico.com>, Cortico Procurement <procurement@cortico.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal window + request to add 8x A100s to Dedicated pool

Hi Soojin,

Hope you're well. We're starting our renewal planning for the Dedicated contract that expires 2026-07-15. Since our product roadmap accelerated, we need to add capacity: +8 A100 cards to our reserved pool (to be active on renewal effective 2026-07-16).

Key asks:
- Amend the current PO so the new GPUs are reserved at the same unit price as today (we'd like to avoid a full repricing review).
- Co-term the additional capacity to the upcoming renewal date (so everything renews 2027-07-15).
- Confirm throughput SLAs for burst workloads (target 600 reqs/min sustained per pool).
- Provide a one-line estimate for proration on the July invoice given the mid-month activation.

Can you confirm process and next steps? We'd like this locked before our board review week (week of 6/22).

Thanks,
Lisa
Director, Cloud Ops
Cortico

--
Attachment: procurement_request_form.pdf (stub)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Huang <lisa@cortico.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal window + request to add 8x A100s to Dedicated pool

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear ask. Quick answers up front then next steps below.

- Process: We can do a PO amendment that adds the 8 A100s as a reserved pool entry and co-terms that capacity to your 2027 renewal date. This will be an amendment to your current order (no new standalone contract).
- Pricing: We can hold your current unit price for the first 12 months on the added GPUs; beyond that the renewal will follow your standard renewal pricing with the rest of the account.
- SLA/Throughput: We can commit to the requested sustained throughput target; will confirm final wording with engineering (we typically attach a throughput appendix).
- Proration: For a 7/16 activation we will prorate at calendar-day accuracy for the remainder of July; preliminary estimate attached.

Next steps I propose:
1) Ben (AE) will draft the amendment language and updated PO items.
2) Vivek (Sales Ops) will run the proration calculation and prepare the billing schedule CSV.
3) I will circulate the amendment + DocuSign link for signature, then coordinate SRE for activation on 7/16.

If that timeline works we'll aim to have the amendment ready for your internal review by Monday 6/15.

Best,
Soojin
Senior Account Manager
Redwood Inference

--
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Huang <lisa@cortico.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 08:43:00 -07:00
Subject: Draft PO amendment + headcount for activation

Hi Lisa — attaching the first draft amendment and the SOW capacity table. High level items included:
- Line item: Dedicated Reserved Pool — +8 x NVIDIA A100 (40GB)
- Term: 2026-07-16 through 2027-07-15 (co-term with existing agreement)
- Unit price: same as current card price for months 1–12; then co-renewed in 2027 pricing exercise
- Activation date: 2026-07-16 (SRE ramp on 7/14 for smoke tests)
- Throughput appendix: commit to 600 reqs/min sustained; will add an SLA appendix with remediation steps

Note on billing: We can pro-rate July as Soojin mentioned; invoice will show a one-line proration adjustment and then the full monthly charge starting August. Vivek, please confirm the proration formula I used (days remaining / total days * monthly charge).

Lisa — I also added Marissa (CS lead) for operational alignment on the activation window. Please review and flag any redlines by EOD Monday 6/15 so we can get this into DocuSign.

Attachments referenced: PO_Amendment_v2.pdf, SOW_capacity_table.xlsx

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

--
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Lisa Huang <lisa@cortico.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO amendment + headcount for activation

Following up with concrete numbers for invoicing/proration: see attached billing_schedule_draft.csv (CSV stub attached).

Assumptions used: monthly charge per A100 = $12,000 (existing unit price), 8 cards = $96,000/month. Activation 2026-07-16 -> July days billed = 16 days (inclusive of 7/16). July days total = 31. Proration = 16/31.

Proration math: 96,000 * (16/31) = $49,612.90 -> July invoice line: "Prorated Dedicated addendum (7/16–7/31)" = $49,612.90.

August invoice will include the full $96,000 monthly line for the additional pool.

Operational notes:
- To meet the SLA we will reserve additional burst capacity on standby the first two weeks post-activation; this is included as a one-time activation fee $3,500 (listed in the amendment).
- Change window: SRE prefers activation on 7/16 at 01:00 UTC for minimal customer impact; will confirm runbook after signature.

Ben — I also prepared a DocuSign powerform link we can send to Lisa once the amendment is final.

Thanks,
Vivek
Sales Operations

--
Attachment: billing_schedule_draft.csv (stub)
From: Tom White <tom.white@cortico.com>

Cc: Lisa Huang <lisa@cortico.com>, Cortico Procurement <procurement@cortico.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Draft PO amendment + headcount for activation

Thanks team — this looks good and matches our internal forecast. Couple of quick points from procurement:
- We can accept the unit price hold for the first 12 months as long as it is explicit in the amendment.
- Please add a one-sentence clause about invoice timing (Net 30 from invoice date) and reference to the original contract number CORT-RED-2023-02.
- We prefer the DocuSign flow; send the link and we will get signatures from finance by 6/19.

Ben/Soojin — please circulate a final DocuSign link and the amended PO PDF when ready.

Tom
Head of Procurement
Cortico
